queries: SELECT tick, year, month FROM ticks ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT tick, demand_kw, supply_kw, outage_fraction, contract_mode, tariff FROM power_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT tick, capacity, demand, load_ratio, failure_rate FROM water_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT tick, AVG(wear) avg_wear, AVG(congestion) avg_congestion, SUM(traffic) traffic FROM road_monthly GROUP BY tick ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT tick, population, arrivals, departures, net FROM migration_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT tick, balance, debt, treasury, income_tax_revenue, property_tax_revenue, utility_revenue, transit_revenue, road_spend, water_sewer_spend FROM budget_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 6
turns.rationale: The main failures are severe: power outages are averaging about 25%, roads are nearly ruined (0.97 wear, 0.78 congestion), and water is already at 85% capacity. The treasury is healthy with no debt, so I’m funding the infrastructure repairs while reducing utility and transit burdens that directly depress satisfaction. I’m switching away from volatile spot power and keeping zoning closed until services stabilize.

SELECT tick,balance,treasury,debt FROM budget_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 4
turns.rationale: Power and roads responded substantially: outages fell from 26% to 17%, and road wear fell to 0.25. Water is the urgent failure, however—the capacity measure collapsed and load ratio exceeded 2.0, with a 41% failure proxy. The current infrastructure spending also creates a roughly 0.48M monthly deficit and debt is rising, so I’ll concentrate water funding at the legal maximum and scale road spending back rather than continuing both at maximum.
